name: Feed Mode Toggle
description: Toggle between local activity (my-activity) and watched activity (watched-activity) modes

scenarios.description: User switches from my-activity to watched-activity mode

template.introduction:
**Switch to Watched Activity**

Switching feed mode to show commits from watched GitHub sources.

events.feed.watched_panel.rendered: [2] Watched items panel rendered: {{watched_users_count}} users, {{watched_repos_count}} repos
events.feed.watched_activity.loaded: [7] Watched activity loaded: {{total_commits}} commits from {{unique_repos}} repos in {{duration_ms}}ms

scenarios.description: User switches from watched-activity to my-activity mode

template.introduction:
**Switch to My Activity**

Switching feed mode to show commits from local repositories.

events.feed.activity.loading_started: [2] Loading local activity: max_repos={{max_repos}}, commits_per_repo={{commits_per_repo}}, limit={{total_limit}}
events.feed.activity.loaded: [4] Local activity loaded: {{total_commits}} commits from {{unique_repos}} repos in {{duration_ms}}ms

template.summary:
**Result:** Switched to my activity mode
- Showing {{commits_displayed}} commits from {{unique_repos}} local repos
